name: bibleget_installation
comment: This wiki's BibleGet installation registration (one row). The token is secret.

columns.name: bi_install_id
columns.comment: UUID generated once by this wiki and kept on re-registration

columns.name: bi_token
columns.comment: Installation token issued by BibleGet; null before the first registration

columns.name: bi_registered_at
columns.comment: Timestamp of the last successful registration

name: bibleget_notice
comment: BibleGet service notices this wiki has seen, one row per notice id (shown to the managers once)

columns.name: bn_id
columns.comment: Notice id from the API, or deprecation:<date> / sunset:<date> for a notice from the headers

columns.name: bn_message
columns.comment: Notice text, plain text (empty for a notice from the headers)

columns.name: bn_link
columns.comment: https link to more information, if any

columns.name: bn_first_seen
columns.comment: When this wiki first received the notice
